text:
Dear Ms Bachmann,

thank you for your call on 2 September. Sorry it has taken me a few days to write back, work has been hectic since I got back.

Keys and locks first, since you mentioned them: my keys weren't involved at all, and I'm not asking you to pay for any lock or key.

I also haven't repaired, cleaned up or thrown away anything that has to do with the theft. Whatever there is to see is still exactly as it was on the day.

You asked whether someone from my household could have been involved. No. I live on my own, and nobody else has a key or stays with me.

And to be clear about where it happened, since I think the first phone call left some confusion: it was not at my flat at Brunnenrain 5 here in Neuchâtel. I was in Bern for the day on Friday 24 July 2026, visiting my friend Laura Widmer, and that's where my camera bag with the camera and two lenses was stolen, worth about CHF 3,250 altogether.

If you need anything else from me, please write or call, I'm usually home in the evenings.

Kind regards,
Hannah Meier
